brief: The canvas displays a continuous, uniform grid composed of interconnected squares set against a near-black background. These squares are perpetually in a slow, rhythmic breathing motion, giving the entire grid a subtle, ambient pulsation. When the viewer clicks anywhere on the grid, an outward-moving wave pulse travels across the surface. As this wave passes through, it temporarily disrupts the affected squares, causing a brief, visible residual shadow that fades slowly over time.

statement: This sketch creates an ambient grid of breathing squares against a dark background. Each square gently pulses in rhythm, creating a subtle, hypnotic effect. When clicked, the grid responds with an outward wave pulse that disrupts nearby squares, leaving lingering shadows that fade slowly. The interaction is both meditative and reactive—allowing viewers to engage with the piece through simple clicks while maintaining an underlying sense of calm motion. The visual effect emerges from a balance between organic breathing motion and precise wave propagation, creating a space where stillness and movement coexist.
